page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc6.6xlarge is a compute-optimized instance from the high clock speed family, designed for computationally intensive tasks that require sustained single-core and parallel processing throughput. Powered by a dedicated 3.1 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor on the x86_64 architecture, this virtual machine provides 24 vCPUs across 12 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled. It incorporates 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a 35 MB shared L3 cache, backed by vector execution instruction sets including AVX-512 and AVX-512 VNNI.

The configuration provides 48.0 GB of memory, resulting in a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Benchmark evaluations place the instance squarely in the median distribution for its core count, achieving a Geekbench multi-core score of 9,628 and a PassMark CPU score of 23,410.97. High-frequency vector and compression capabilities are reflected in a Clang compilation score of 19,083 and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression throughput of 107.42 GB/sec. Memory subsystem testing shows large-block read throughput of 102.76 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 36.67 GB/sec.

Hardware tradeoffs center around storage and graphical capabilities. The instance includes 0 GB of bundled local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for operating system and application data. It features an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth allocation, zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and no discrete GPUs. Without local NVMe drives, extreme IOPS disk profiles are offloaded across the network interface. For inference workloads, it delivers 34.41 tokens per second on prompt processing and 12.51 tokens per second for generation on 7B parameter models.

In qualitative terms of cost efficiency, the ecs.hfc6.6xlarge delivers predictable dedicated compute resources without excess memory overhead. The 1:2 memory configuration avoids paying for unutilized RAM in pure compute situations. The instance fits high-throughput web serving, software build pipelines, batch computation, scientific simulations, CI/CD runners, and application tier workloads requiring consistent Intel CPU execution cycles.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc6.6xlarge is a high-clock-speed, compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture. Driven by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 3.1 GHz, it features 24 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 12 physical cores with hyperthreading, alongside 48.0 GB of RAM. The instance lacks integrated local storage and GPU hardware, relying on an 8 Gbps baseline network interface to access external persistent block storage. Benchmark assessments report a PassMark CPU score of 23,410.97, Geekbench multi-core performance of 9,628, and a static web serving throughput of 16.94 GB/sec. Supporting advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and AVX-512 VNNI, it offers an efficient balance of processing speed and moderate memory footprint. The configuration is suited for code compilation pipelines, web application hosting, continuous integration, batch data processing, and general compute-heavy enterprise tasks.
